name: create(all)
gap: Native packages do not expose a mathjs DI container. Each package is imported directly. compat create(all) reproduces the container.

name: factory()
gap: mathjs factory(name, dependencies, fn) is implemented in core/src/factory.ts and exported from @danielsimonjr/mathts-core/internal, not from the package root. The root symbol create on @danielsimonjr/mathts-core is typed-function create(), a different function. compat exports factory() at the package root.

name: import() override/wrap/silent
gap: mathjs instance.import({override,wrap,silent}) is attached inside create(). Native packages export importFactory from @danielsimonjr/mathts-functions (the factory, not an instance method) and do not export a binding named import. compat instances expose import().

name: config() number/matrix/precision/relTol/absTol/predictable/randomSeed/legacySubset/numberFallback
gap: functions config() and core DEFAULT_CONFIG include those keys (core/src/config.ts). Public config() in functions/src/config-api.ts writes DEFAULT_CONFIG directly and does not map deprecated epsilon (that mapping exists only on functions/src/core/function/config.ts, used by the compat instance). There is one process-wide config, not one config per create() instance. runWithConfig overlays are synchronous only.

name: on('config') / off / once / emit
gap: functions/src/core/function/config.ts emits config on the instance emitter, and functions/src/core/create.ts mixes on/off/once/emit onto a math object. Those names are not exported from native package entries (#1568). compat instances expose them.

name: typed extensibility
gap: Native typed-function is @danielsimonjr/mathts-typed-function plus core mathTyped / createMathTSTyped. It is not the same object as mathjs instance.typed, which compat reconstructs.

name: reviver / replacer
gap: Exported from @danielsimonjr/mathts-functions (factories/evaluate.ts and utils/json-replacer.ts). JSON shape was not differentially tested in this review.

name: chain() / Chain
gap: chain and Chain are public native exports. Method-list equality with mathjs Chain was not re-checked in this pass.

name: help() and embedded docs
gap: help and docs/embeddedDocs are native exports (functions help.ts, expression embeddedDocs). Coverage of every mathjs example string was not re-run here.

name: version
gap: core VERSION is the MathTS version string.

name: expression.mathWithTransform
gap: functions/src/factories/index.ts builds _mathWithTransform and expression transforms exist as create*Transform in @danielsimonjr/mathts-expression. There is no public native math.expression.mathWithTransform object; compat/src/instance-api.ts publishes that object.

name: 0-based programmatic index vs 1-based expression index
gap: Programmatic subset/index stay 0-based. Expression transforms in expression/src/transform are 1-based inside the expression language, matching mathjs. Callers of the native functions (not evaluate) use 0-based indexes.

name: expression sandbox (customs, blocked prototype access)
gap: expression/src/utils/customs.ts is mandatory for property access. mathjs evaluate() assigns and calls help/parse/derivative inside expressions. Native evaluate blocks assignment and a denylist of host methods. That is a security invariant, not an unfinished port.

name: bigint number type
gap: The bigint constructor is a public functions export. config.number includes "bigint" (core/src/config.ts) and the expression literal parser handles that case (functions/src/factories/evaluate.ts).

name: BigNumber class
gap: core BigNumber is MathTS’s own decimal type with precision config. mathjs BigNumber is decimal.js. The class is public and used by the same config.precision knob; value-level rounding parity with decimal.js was not re-measured in this review.

name: Complex
gap: core Complex is a public class (polar helpers live on the class). Trig of Complex is on the functions layer. Bit-identity with mathjs complex.js was not re-measured here.

name: Fraction
gap: core Fraction is public. Exact equality with fraction.js edge cases was not re-measured here.

name: Unit, prefixes, createUnit, to, toBest, splitUnit, physical constants
gap: Unit, createUnit, to, toBest, and splitUnit are public native exports, and the physical constants are individual functions exports. This review did not line-diff every prefix and valueless unit against mathjs type/unit.

name: DenseMatrix
gap: matrix DenseMatrix is the native matrix. Storage format matches the mathjs dense array-of-arrays model at the type level.

name: SparseMatrix
gap: Public class in @danielsimonjr/mathts-matrix. This review did not re-measure CCS explicit-zero density against mathjs.

name: Index
gap: mathjs Index (a matrix subscript) is createIndexClass in functions/src/type/matrix/MatrixIndex.ts. It is stored on the functions factory scope and is not a package-entry export. The native symbol Index is a different class: tensor named-axis Index in tensor/src/named-index.ts. compat/src/named-symbols.ts exports the mathjs Index.

name: ResultSet
gap: expression/src/index.ts exports ResultSet. Block expressions in the sandboxed evaluator may still not return a ResultSet the way mathjs does; that behavior is tracked under the expression sandbox row.

name: Map / ObjectWrappingMap / PartitionedMap
gap: core/src/map.ts implements PartitionedMap and ObjectWrappingMap. They are public on @danielsimonjr/mathts-core/internal, not on the core "." entry. mathjs uses these as the internal Map type behind object scopes; native expressions use ordinary objects plus these classes internally.

name: AST node classes
gap: expression/src/index.ts exports the node classes and create* factories. toTex/toHTML/toString/transform/traverse exist on the node base. Custom handler parity was not exhaustively diffed.

name: Parser get/set/getAll/remove/clear and JSON
gap: expression Parser is public. Scope mutation through evaluate is sandboxed (assignment disabled), so parser.evaluate("x = 1") does not match mathjs. JSON serialization of a parser was not differentially tested.

name: mathjs CLI / REPL
gap: No mathjs-compatible REPL binary. @danielsimonjr/mathts-workbook ships the mtsw CLI (run/validate/graph) for .mtsw notebooks.

name: ESM/CJS/UMD and mathjs/number lightweight bundle
gap: Native packages are ESM-only (no CJS, no UMD browser bundle, no mathjs/number entry). Tree-shaking is per package import. compat is also ESM.

name: ArgumentsError, DimensionError, IndexError
gap: ArgumentsError is exported from @danielsimonjr/mathts-functions. DimensionError and IndexError are exported from @danielsimonjr/mathts-core.

name: TypeScript types
gap: mathjs ships types/*.d.ts for a JS codebase. MathTS is TypeScript and emits .d.ts per package via tsc. The type surface is larger than mathjs and is not a drop-in of mathjs types.
